stories.title: Formal objections open on plan to merge Catholic schools in Mold, Flint and Saltney
stories.summary: A 28-day window for formal objections to plans to close four Catholic schools in Flintshire and replace them with a single 3-18 school in Flint opened today. stories.title: Former Shotton vape shop could become family-run crepe and coffee takeaway
stories.summary: A family-run crepe, coffee and bakery takeaway could open in a former vape shop in Shotton if planning permission is granted. stories.title: Flintshire birth registrations now need ID as electronic register replaces paper books
stories.summary: Parents registering a baby’s birth in Flintshire now have to bring identification showing their full current first name and surname. stories.title: Mold record-breaker Sean Conway publishes 420-page guide to iron-distance triathlon
stories.summary: Mold endurance adventurer Sean Conway, who set a world record in 2023 by completing 105 iron-distance triathlons in 105 days around Flintshire, has written a 420-page guide for people taking on their first.
